titulo: Marine Le Pen hails RN senate surge as ‘milestone’ towards French presidency
cuerpo: National Rally and allies gain record 14 seats and can form senate group for first time after indirect vote by local officials The French far-right leader Marine Le Pen has said her 2027 presidential campaign will be boosted after her anti-immigration party, the National Rally (RN), and its allies improved to a record 14 seats in partial senate elections this weekend. Le Pen called the results a “historic victory” and a “major milestone” after her party cleared the 10-seat threshold to be able to form a senate group for the first time, after an indirect vote by local officials including mayors and councillors.
